CREATE TABLE "public"."guildConfig" (
  "autoRoleEnabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "autoRoleId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "goodbyeChannelId" text,
  "goodbyeEnabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "goodbyeMessage" text DEFAULT '{displayName} left **{server}**. We now have {memberCount} members.' NOT NULL,
  "guildId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "loggingChannelId" text,
  "loggingEnabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "setupCompleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "welcomeChannelId" text,
  "welcomeEnabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "welcomeMessage" text DEFAULT 'Welcome {user} to **{server}**! You are member #{memberCount}.' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
